The graphics are not the problem, the survival mode is unplayable, you shouldn’t have to spend hours researching to figure it out, in fact ui design and ux seem like foreign terms to the devs… nothing in this game is intuitive except that paying ahead of time makes no sense. Nice concepts, here is a bubble elevator to move something 3 spaces, however you need a 5x8 grid to execute it, don’t have that much room, well you can use redstone if you have the patience and don’t mind a clicking noise you can hear in your sleep and it barely saves space. I really hate this game, it gives a bad name to survival games and I have played most. This is the absolute worst.  The cheats aren’t cheats, they are essential because it is intolerable without them. Build a shelter so you can hide 50% of the time. By the way, we will start you in a vertical biome where movement is highly challenging — good luck. By, the way, got a problem. Use redstone, now you have two. Every so-called solution is a step into a nightmarish layering of impossible options designed to make you regret trying in the first place — and I do. I love some things about this game, but mostly I love leaving it… also the movement is sluggish even on an iPad Pro…
